description: Allawasaya Textile and Finishing Mills Limited is a public limited company whose two spinning units stand in the Mumtazabad Industrial Area of Multan, running 46,488 spindles. It spins polyester-cotton blended and CVC yarn in counts Ne 10 to 40 under the brand name 'Gumbad', and runs its own gas-fired captive power plant so that both units have an uninterrupted supply. The company was incorporated in 1958 as M. Allah Wasaya & Co Ltd, took its present name in 1960 and was listed on the Karachi Stock Exchange in 1965; the cloth-processing business it started with was discontinued in 1978 and spinning has been its activity since.
headOffice: Allawasaya Square, Mumtazabad Industrial Area, Vehari Road, Multan, Pakistan

products.name: Gumbad polyester-cotton blended yarn
products.summary: Blended polyester-cotton yarn (52:48) and CVC, in counts Ne 10 to 40, sold under the company's 'Gumbad' brand.

products.name: Captive power generation
products.summary: A 4.24 MW captive plant of three Jenbacher JGS 420 gas generators, installed in 2007-08 to supply both spinning units.

products.name: Carded and combed cotton yarn
products.summary: The company's earlier product line - cotton carded and combed yarn - which it spun from its first spinning unit in 1964 onward and continues to describe as high quality yarn.
